My services

What I bring to the team at Authlab

My work goes well beyond a single job title. These are the areas I cover for the team, day to day.

Web Design Guiding

Guiding the layout and design of web and landing pages so each page supports its message and its conversion goal.

Sales & Marketing

Planning campaigns and messaging that move readers from first visit to sign-up or purchase.

Data Analytics

Reading traffic, rankings and campaign data to decide what to publish, update or promote next.

Business Development

Project Management

About

More about me

I studied law, and then found my way into marketing. The two have more in common than people expect.

Law taught me how to research properly, read carefully, build a clear argument, and pay attention to the small details that change the outcome.

What kept pulling me toward marketing was the audience. I wanted to understand why people pick one option over another, how an idea lands, and how data can make those calls less of a guess.
